headline: BLS International Services Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange that BLS International FZE, Wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has subscribed 100% share capital of BLS International Services Japan Co. Ltd.
detail: Acquisition - BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange that BLS International FZE, Wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has subscribed 100% share capital of BLS International Services Japan Co. Ltd. ( BLS Japan ).
